title: Oracle and King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre to Advance Healthcare Innovation in Saudi Arabia
summary: Collaboration will connect clinical, genomic, and research data to help enhance patient care and accelerate scientific discovery.
body_markdown:
Austin, Texas—Oct 1, 2026


Oracle Health and[King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/) (KFSH) today announced a shared interest, under a non-binding memorandum of understanding, in exploring a strategic collaboration to build an intelligent, continuously learning healthcare ecosystem that connects clinical, genomic, and research data. By combining KFSH’s clinical and research capabilities with Oracle’s cloud, data, and AI technology, the organizations will equip clinicians with timely insights at the point of care, help researchers accelerate the discovery of new treatments, and support enhanced patient experiences across the Kingdom. The work will support Saudi Vision 2030 and strengthen Saudi Arabia’s position as a global leader in healthcare innovation.


Healthcare organizations face a growing challenge with clinical, genomic, and research data often spread across systems, making it difficult to turn information into timely action. Oracle’s secure cloud infrastructure, connected data platform, and AI capabilities will help KFSH bring this information together, equipping care teams with relevant insights at the point of care and helping researchers move quickly from data to discovery.


“KFSH is committed to shaping the future of healthcare in Saudi Arabia. By bringing together our clinical and research leadership with Oracle’s technology, we will improve the care experience for patients, accelerate innovation, and contribute to a stronger, more sustainable healthcare system for the Kingdom,” said H.E. Dr. Majid Al Fayyadh, CEO, King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre.


Oracle Health and KFSH will work together to:


- **Connect care:** Link data across the healthcare ecosystem to enhance care coordination.
- **Advance personalized medicine:** Use clinical, genomic, and research insights to tailor prevention, diagnosis, and treatment.
- **Enable AI-driven healthcare:** Apply responsible AI to equip clinicians with relevant information at the point of care.
- **Accelerate research:** Use data to help accelerate biomedical discovery and bring new insights into patient care.


“Our collaboration with KFSH reflects a shared commitment to harnessing the full value of healthcare data, genomics, and AI to transform patient care and accelerate innovation,” said Seema Verma, executive vice president and general manager, Oracle Health and Life Sciences. “By creating a connected, intelligent healthcare ecosystem, KFSH can equip clinicians and researchers with the insights they need to enhance care delivery, advance discovery, and elevate healthcare experiences at scale across Saudi Arabia.”


To learn more about how Oracle Health is helping transform healthcare, visit[www.oracle.com/health](https://www.oracle.com/health/) .

## About King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre


King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre (KFSH) is a leading tertiary care and academic medical centre in Saudi Arabia, with facilities in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Madinah. Established in 1975, KFSH provides specialized care in areas including oncology, organ transplantation, cardiovascular medicine, neurosciences, and genetics, and serves as a national referral centre for complex cases. KFSH is consistently ranked among the world’s leading academic medical centres and is a key contributor to the health sector transformation under Saudi Vision 2030. For more information, visit www.[kfshrc.edu.sa](https://kfshrc.edu.sa/) .
